caption: Figure 3: DPA-Store architecture: (I) Request packets are assigned on-path to a DPA traverser thread, which (II) walks a NIC-side learned index. (III) Values are fetched per DMA using leaf-level models, and (IV) inserts are placed in leaf-level insert buffers. (V) The host performs structural update

templates.why_chosen: Double-column, dense figure mirrors the identical learned-index tree on both sides of a dashed NIC-Host PCIe divider, using matched cyan/orange region colors and green-highlighted 'new' nodes to show structural updates crossing the boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: Mirror the exact same data structure on both sides of the host/device boundary using two background tints (cyan device, orange host), reuse identical node names on both copies but recolor the ones a structural update just changed, and route curved cross-boundary arrows to carry the sync messages by name (patch, stitch).
